name: io.github.pedrogbraz/cronus-ui
title: Cronus UI
description: Search, install, compose, add-page, and theme Cronus UI from the live registry.

environmentVariables.name: CRONUS_UI_REGISTRY
environmentVariables.description: Override the registry source (URL or local directory).

environmentVariables.name: CRONUS_MCP_CLI_TIMEOUT_MS
